address_help: Learners and teachers can type this address if their device does not find the Hub.
address_none: Connect this PC to the classroom router to get a Hub address.
error_body: Another program may be using port 8080 or 8081. Close it, then open L.A.R.A Hub again.
admin_setup_help: Set up the school admin on this Hub PC. This account manages accounts and PIN resets.
admin_login_help: Enter the PIN for ADMIN-0001 on this Hub PC.
admin_pin_help: Use four digits, including any leading zeros.
admin_existing_action: Admin already set up? Sign in
admin_exists: The admin is already set up. Enter the admin PIN to sign in.
admin_accounts_help: Create teacher or learner accounts and reset forgotten PINs.
admin_empty_body: Create an account or refresh the list when the Hub is available.
admin_pin_once: Give this PIN privately to the account owner. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved after closing.
admin_offline_body: Showing the last loaded accounts. Changes need the Hub. Your form stays open. If a save was interrupted, refresh accounts before trying again.
admin_offline_auth: The Hub is not responding. Keep this window open and try again when the Hub is running.
admin_session_expired: Your admin session ended. Sign in again.
admin_wrong_pin: The admin PIN was not accepted. Check it and try again.
admin_duplicate: That ID or LRN already has an account. Refresh accounts before trying again.
admin_rate_limit: Too many PIN attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
admin_not_found: That account was not found. Refresh accounts and try again.
admin_forbidden: Only the Hub admin on the Hub PC can use this console.
admin_invalid: Check the account details and enter a 4-digit PIN.
admin_error: The Hub could not confirm this change. Refresh accounts before trying again.
